verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a project-management SaaS like Basecamp, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a self-hosted or on-premises deployment of the core product. The evidence covers hosted features, pricing tiers, the REST API, the CLI and MCP support, none of which amounts to self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
